mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized growth exceeds 2%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE drops below 5%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances where RSAFS shows sustained growth, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply chain, leading to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declines > 1% MoM, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals increased demand for housing, which boosts related industries and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST increases > 10% MoM, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with an increase in GDP (GDPC1) signals accommodative monetary policy supporting economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases and GDPC1 increases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in GDP (GDPC1) signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where GDPC1 shows sustained decline, the hypothesis is rejected.
